summary: Tested Lousa TV public link + Rompimento (Claude IA) features end-to-end. Backend 8/8 passed (token gen, rotate, public grid no-auth, sla_map has 'rompimento' key, 404 on invalid token, Claude parse-preview rejects short text, accepts valid text returning items, full ticket rompimento creation + admin-open + rompimento-finalize working). Frontend: Lousa TV portal (without token) shows token input correctly; with valid token renders dark Kanban with 'LOUSA TV' header, 5 colaboradores em campo, SLA bolha cards, real-time clock; audio toggle works ('Ativar áudio + TTS' -> 'Áudio ATIVO'). Admin panel '📺 TV' button (data-testid lousa-tv-link-btn) opens LousaTvLinkModal showing full public URL with Copy/Open/Rotate buttons.

minor.issue: Public open endpoint requires técnico to have ponto de entrada batido — for full E2E test had to use /admin-open endpoint instead. Expected behavior, but a docs note would help.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in Column.js rendering. Cosmetic console noise, render still works.

issues: Dark theme renders correctly; SLA bubble border colors visible; auto-refresh 20s implied by header text

action_items: Optional: fix React 'unique key' warning in LousaTvPanel/Column children for cleaner console.

Main agent can self-verify CreateTicketModal rompimento option opens (likely needs technician column pre-selected). Code at CreateTicketModal.js:61 already has <option value='rompimento'>💥 Rompimento</option>.

Frontend LousaMobile rompimento-close-form (data-testid='rompimento-close-form') not E2E tested via Playwright because requires técnico login flow + ponto de entrada + open ticket. Code verified to exist (early-return in LousaMobile.js around line 2278 per ref). Main agent should self-test or assign collaborator portal testing.
critical_code_review_comments: lousa_rompimento.py is clean: Pydantic models, proper async/await, excludes _id, Claude error handling with 502/503 returns, AI prompt is comprehensive PT-BR with catalog injection, sanitizes items (rounds 'un' to int, drops unknown ids).
lousa_tv.py is minimal & correct: UUID4 hex (32 chars) tokens, persisted in company_settings, public grid endpoint reuses lousa_grid via synthetic user dict (clean reuse).
Public grid endpoint requires token len >= 16 — good defensive check.
rompimento-finalize correctly enforces ticket.type=='rompimento', status=='aberta', collaborator match, and allows negative stock with shortages notification to gestor.
Minor: rompimento-finalize 'completion_data' fills 0 for all standard fields to keep schema compat — sensible.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (TV portal + admin TV modal verified; CreateTicketModal modal open + LousaMobile rompimento form not interactively verified, but source code confirms data-testids and rompimento option exist)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Lousa TV (tv-link, rotate, public/tv-grid/{token}) and Rompimento Claude IA (parse-preview, rompimento-finalize) are fully working — 8 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_lousa_tv_rompimento.py serve as regression. CreateTicketModal modal didn't open via simple '+ Nova nota' click during test — may require choosing a column first; code-level check confirms ticket-type select + rompimento option present. LousaMobile RompimentoCloseForm not E2E tested (requires collaborator login + ponto entrada flow). Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration via emergentintegrations confirmed real & responsive (~3-5s).
